spoilers.text: An unreleased episode of BLEACH: Thousand-Year Blood War (Episode 44) is currently being illegally streamed and distributed on Discord. To make matters worse, the person behind this is publicly posting leaked screenshots right here on Twitter/X: nitter.net/JaymesHanson/status/20… This is far more than a simple leak - this person is directly profiting from stolen intellectual property. Not only is he charging a £10 GBP entry fee just to access the livestream, but he is also selling unreleased episodes for £50 GBP. @BLEACHanimation @studiopierrot @SHUEISHA_PR @dentsu_global @VIZMedia I’m making this public to raise awareness and ensure the official production committee sees this so they can file a formal incident report and shut this down. Where the stream is happening: - Platform: Discord - Offending User Alias: jaymeshanson - Offending User ID: 1204047794029985862 - Server ID: 1043914612095070268 Monetization & Payment Methods: - PayPal: jaymeshanson@gmail.com - Patreon: patreon.com/JaymesHanson Connected Socials & Platforms: - Twitter/X: @jaymeshanson - Kick: kick.com/jaymeshanson - Instagram: @jaymeshanson Please help spread the word and report this so we can stop the unauthorized spread of unreleased production material.
